brief: docs/PLAN.md §3 piece W1-01 — World shape and the traversal budget
findings: world-scale.json is authoritative: world box x[0,4822] z[0,5540]; RI-WLD01 prose says 4825x5540 — use 4825 for the box, tolerance ±25m in M1.
Crossing = Stormhold->Helstrom->Blackrose->Lilmoth = 2921+2485+1503 = 6909 m; 6909/2.0/60 = 57.575 min. Legs come from roads[] with sinuosity 1.45/1.45/1.45.
RI-WLD01 M3 anti-cheat: <=8% of speed samples on road may be below 1.6 m/s.
RI-WLD04 M18: 9 axes, every one of 78 pairs must differ on >=6.

RI-WLD10 M47 census script exists at corpus/80-methods/m-wld10-water-census.mjs; it reads game/data/world/water.json. Exact tidal set: Crimson Coast, Eastern Rootlands, Marauder's Coast, Stone Wastes, Western Rootlands.
W1-00 shipped game/ with fixed-step loop, seeded PRNG (core/rng.js), determinism trap (core/guards.js), render/scene.js = 420m patch at origin. W1-01 replaces the patch with the province.
HARNESS §7 data layout requires game/data/world/regions.json + pois.json + settlements/<id>.json
ANOTHER BUILDER (W1-09 combat core) IS EDITING game/src CONCURRENTLY. engine.js, sim/step.js, sim/player.js replaced by game/src/combat/*. Re-read files before editing; commit only W1-01 paths.

Landmask: jpeg-js in tools/node_modules decodes the map. Water = b-r>15 && b>=g-2. Parchment is INDISTINGUISHABLE by colour from Clay Moor/Stone Forest; separated by flood fill from Helstrom with the white border as a barrier + 3px dilation. 14.27 km2 / 65.5% of bbox == RI-WLD01's own figure.

Terrain model: 25 m raster (193x222). base_dm = region-painted macro landform blurred sigma=7 cells; detail added analytically by game/src/world/noise.js detailAt (shared with the builder). depth = max(table-g, wtop-g, seaDepth). Per-region water table offset SOLVED by bisection so built WCI == RI-WLD10 §8 declared WCI exactly for all 13.

Ocean vs channel: a water cell >=90 m from land is ocean (ramps land to sea level); anything narrower is an incision in the local surface. Without this every river became a 300 m gorge through Valus Ridge.
MEASURED: elevation -41.8..424.2 m; land 14.24 km2; below +5 m 34.8%; above +100 m 19.6%; area-weighted mean slope 8.7 deg; Valus max 424 m, Salt Hills 269 m.
m-wld10-water-census PASSES (WCI 0.294, spread 0.86, 5 dry, 2 bone dry, 2 drowned, 11 classes, 5 tidal). m-wld11-hazard-census PASSES (19 hazards, 13 signatures, 1 KILL, 8 zero-damage).
hazards.json needs 6 NON-signature hazards or two regions share a hazard shape (M63 static half) — 13 signatures over 6 classes collide by pigeonhole.
next_step: build roads.json (sinuosity solved to RI-WLD01 §4 path_m), then game/src/world/field.js runtime sampler, then province renderer + streaming, then harness extensions and measurement tools
notes_for_successor: Build order: build-landmask -> build-regions -> build-terrain -> build-water-hazards -> build-roads. All are idempotent. terrain.json is generated, do not hand-edit.
